sections.title: Arsenal
sections.html:
Arsenal beat Hull City 1–0 in the Premier League. Martin Ødegaard scored the only goal in the 72nd minute, and no assist is listed for it.

Arsenal are first in the table on 27 points from 10 games. Their last five matches read 4W 1D 0L, and they are unbeaten in nine. Hull City dropped from 11th to 13th and have 11 points from 10 games.

Next up

  • Sun 22 Nov, 1:30am · Newcastle United (away) · EPL
  • Wed 25 Nov, 4am · Borussia Dortmund (home) · CL
  • Mon 30 Nov, 12:30am · Manchester City (home) · EPL

Nottingham Forest beat Manchester City 3–1, with Jair Cunha scoring in the 6th minute and Liam Delap in the 18th and 73rd.

Rayan Cherki replied for City in the 52nd minute.

Forest climbed from 19th to 16th on 9 points; City stay second on 21.

Noah Okafor scored in the 79th minute to give Leeds United a 1–0 win over Tottenham Hotspur. Leeds climbed from 12th to 8th on 14 points, while Tottenham dropped from 9th to 10th on 12.

Fulham and Newcastle United drew 1–1. Jacob Murphy put Newcastle ahead in the 80th minute, and Rodrigo Muniz levelled for Fulham in the 83rd.

Newcastle climbed from 13th to 11th on 12 points; Fulham are 15th on 10.
